issuer: the Illinois Secretary of State, Driver Services
note: The Secretary of State's basic fees page (read 2026-10-30) gives a driver's licence, ages 21 to 68, at $30 (ages 18 to 20, $5) and a five-year state ID card, ages 18 to 64, at $20; the FAQ says a licence is valid for 4 years and an ID card for 5. The $30 licence is kept from 21, the youngest age it is issued at (a driver under 21 is under the graduated licence programme, the licence page says; the $5 licence of 18 to 20 isn't held). No youngest age for the card was read (cards are sold under 18).

sources.title: Illinois Secretary of State, Basic Fees
sources.said: Driver's License – Persons ages 21 to 68 $30 ... State ID Card – Five-year, ages 18–64 $20

sources.title: Illinois Secretary of State, Driver's License and State ID FAQ
sources.said: An Illinois driver's license is valid for 4 years. An Illinois ID card is valid for 5 years.

sources.title: Illinois Secretary of State, Driver's License and State ID Card Information
sources.said: If you are under 21, please review the Graduated Driver's License page.
